svg.title: Offline firmware installation
svg.desc: Inspect, install and verify from one local Companion window.

g.text: Inspect, install and verify from one local Companion window.
Portable Windows 10/11 x64 EXE; no Python installation or hosted service required.
Use bundled or local firmware files. The app does not automatically download updates.
Supported layouts are checked; progress and exportable logs remain visible. Unknown layouts are not force-
Actual Companion browser capture / example library / no unit connected
